de.abas.ceks.jedp

Class EDPException

  • Object
    • Throwable
      • Exception
        • EDPException
  • All Implemented Interfaces:
    EDPExceptionContext, Serializable
    Direct Known Subclasses:
    CantBeginEditException, CantBeginSessionException, CantChangeSettingException, CantExecuteShellException, CantReadEditorChangesException, CantReadSettingException, CantReadStatusException, CantSaveException, CantSetDialogAnswerException, CantSetEditorObservationException, FieldOperationException, InvalidQueryException, InvalidRowOperationException, LockException, ServerActionException, TransactionException

    public class EDPException
extends Exception
implements EDPExceptionContext
    Super class of all checked EDP exceptions. If the action exception has been triggered by a NAK of the EDP server, the error number and message of that NAK is available, as well as the error messages which have been sent by the server together with the NAK message.
    Version:
    1
    Author:
    xg
